fato_historico: 1983: Soyuz 7K-ST No. 16L, intended to launch a crew to the Salyut 7 space station, explodes on the launch pad. The launch escape system is activated before the Soyuz-U rocket explodes, saving the crew.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you might find strength in unexpected moments of pause. Much like a mission that pivots just before the threshold, you may feel an intuitive nudge to protect your energy today. It is a good time to trust your instincts, ensuring your personal voyage stays grounded while your ambitions reach toward the infinite cosmic horizons.
frase_do_dia: Even when plans shift suddenly, your inner compass points you toward safer ground.
significado_numero: Represents the power of sudden shifts leading to miraculous personal protection.
conselho: Consider safety as your greatest strength while you pursue your loftiest professional goals.
